decisions.reason: As a newly launched dietary supplement line with several models that builds directly on the existing portfolio, it offers option value at low carrying cost and fits the firm's expansion in consumer health.
This skin and hair supplement is closely related to the established offer and was actively launched on its own page, so management would likely keep it while market acceptance is still unfolding.
The joint health supplement is a recent adjacent product with limited negative evidence so far, making it sensible to retain while uncertainty about demand remains.
Although the mushroom-based immune supplement looks more niche and is only lightly featured, its likely low continuation cost supports keeping the option open for another year.

The generic blood pressure medication already shows a quality or regulatory problem signal and likely has higher carrying and reputational costs, so its downside now outweighs the option value of continuing.
